reason: A Cordis plugin that connects agent runs to an external phone service for calls, texts, voice-transcribed replies, approval responses, and session follow-ups; its primary user-facing purpose is agent notifications and reachability.

summaries.zh: 通过外部电话服务向用户发起电话或短信通知，并将语音或短信回复传回智能体会话。
summaries.en: Connects agent sessions to an external phone service for calls, text notifications, and returning voice or text replies to the run.

capabilities: Places outbound phone calls through an external service
Receives phone replies and delivers them to agent sessions
Transcribes spoken answers for agent input
Can route voice answers into approval decisions
Can resume, steer, or inject messages into agent runs
